title: Mobile App Development Timeline Benchmarks
content:
Mobile App Development Timeline Benchmarks

Industry-standard timeline ranges for mobile application projects based on scope and complexity.

## MVP (Minimum Viable Product) — Core Features Only
- Simple app (1-3 screens, no backend): 1–3 months
- Moderate app (5-10 screens, REST API, auth): 3–5 months
- Complex app (10+ screens, custom backend, third-party APIs): 4–8 months

## Full-Featured Consumer App (iOS + Android)
- Basic consumer app with user accounts: 4–7 months
- Social or marketplace app: 6–10 months
- E-commerce app with payment integration: 5–9 months
- AI-powered app with LLM/ML features: 6–12 months
- Healthcare or fintech regulated app: 8–14 months

## Enterprise Mobile App
- Internal enterprise tool (1 platform): 3–6 months
- Cross-platform enterprise app with SSO: 6–10 months
- Enterprise app with offline sync and complex data: 8–14 months

## Key Phase Duration Benchmarks
- Discovery & Requirements: 2–4 weeks
- UX/UI Design & Prototyping: 4–8 weeks
- Backend API Development: 6–16 weeks (depends on complexity)
- iOS Development: 6–16 weeks
- Android Development: 6–16 weeks (can run parallel to iOS)
- AI/ML Feature Integration: 4–12 weeks (per feature set)
- Third-Party API Integration (per API): 1–3 weeks
- Payment Gateway Integration (Stripe, Klarna, etc.): 2–4 weeks per gateway
- QA & Testing: 3–6 weeks
- App Store Submission & Review: 1–3 weeks
- Post-launch stabilization: 2–4 weeks

## Common Estimation Errors to Avoid
- Do NOT assume each API integration takes 3+ months — typical integrations are 2–4 weeks
- Do NOT serialize tasks that can run in parallel (iOS and Android dev can overlap)
- Do NOT estimate 44+ months for a standard consumer mobile app — this is always incorrect
- A well-resourced team (5-8 people) should deliver a full-featured AI app in 9–14 months maximum
- Buffer time should be 10–20% of total estimate, not additive per task

## Realistic Example: AI-Powered Consumer App with Payment Integration
- Scope: Mobile app (iOS + Android), AI search, 3 payment gateways, location APIs
- Realistic timeline: 10–14 months total
- Team: PM, UI/UX Designer, 2 Mobile Devs, 2 Backend Devs, 1 AI/ML Engineer, 1 QA
- NOT 36–44 months — that estimate reflects enterprise-scale misapplication

## Period Label Selection for Gantt Charts
- Projects < 6 months: use WEEKS as Gantt period unit
- Projects 6–18 months: use MONTHS as Gantt period unit
- Projects > 18 months: use QUARTERS as Gantt period unit (never months — too many columns)
- Example: 12-month project → monthly Gantt (12 columns)
- Example: 44-month project → quarterly Gantt (15 columns), NOT monthly (44 columns)
